meaning: Forward tape of the perpetual venue: ten book levels each side, funding rate, open interest, mark and oracle price, fifteen second cadence, markets BTC, ETH, GAS and SPX
availability: results/cascade-tape.json summarises it and data/tape holds the samples, written by scripts/collect_tape.py. Forward only: the archive begins at its first sample
falsifier: The venue stops serving public endpoints, or the collector stops running

meaning: The rate a leveraged position pays to hold, the price of carry on the venue
availability: on the tape every fifteen seconds from the first sample
falsifier: Funding carries no information about the path of the price after a forced closing

meaning: Contracts outstanding, which falls when positions are closed by the engine rather than by choice
availability: on the tape every fifteen seconds from the first sample
falsifier: Open interest falls without any subsequent path difference, which would make the trigger meaningless

meaning: Mark price minus oracle price, the venue's own statement of premium or discount to the index
availability: on the tape every fifteen seconds from the first sample
falsifier: Basis returns to zero instantly, which would say the venue reprices without friction

meaning: Size available within ten basis points of the mid, which is what a forced flow consumes
availability: on the tape every fifteen seconds. Median 3.5 million dollars on BTC, 8.7 million on ETH, 1,169 on GAS and 3,991 on SPX
falsifier: Depth is unchanged through a cascade, which would say the flow is absorbed without cost

meaning: How far the marginal leveraged position sits from its maintenance margin threshold
blocker: account level leverage is not public. Open interest and funding are visible, positions are not, so margin distance can only be inferred from a book and an aggregate
falsifier: A public leverage or margin aggregate appears and the inference becomes unnecessary

meaning: The venue engine closes a position when maintenance margin is crossed, so the resulting flow is price insensitive by rule rather than by opinion
availability: stated in docs/plan/cascade-protocol.md, committed before collection
falsifier: Observed closings turn out to be voluntary at the prices where the threshold should bind

meaning: A sample where the price move exceeds three trailing deviations and open interest falls by one percent against its trailing median, the declared trigger
blocker: zero triggers in roughly 440 minutes across four markets. The trigger is declared and armed, and no cascade has been observed yet
falsifier: Triggers are never observed, which would leave the conditional path untestable on this tape

meaning: After a trigger fires, the path at one, five, fifteen and sixty samples is measurably different from an unconditional path in the same market
unit: distribution of returns after the trigger
availability: not yet measurable: it needs triggers
falsifier: Post trigger paths are indistinguishable from the unconditional distribution

meaning: The pre-registered cascade protocol: declared trigger, declared measurement points, clustering against a Poisson null, and a stated ceiling of descriptive until a cascade is observed
availability: docs/plan/cascade-protocol.md, committed before the first sample
falsifier: The protocol is amended after data arrives, which would void it

meaning: The BTC perpetual contract on the venue, a twenty four hour instrument where a short is available without borrow
availability: taped every fifteen seconds since the first sample
falsifier: The BTC market is delisted or its book stops publishing
